VI.description: Headless DQMH Convert Event. Converts ONE plain Request of ONE DQMH module in the ACTIVE project into a Request and Wait for Reply by calling Delacor's own scripting VIs as STATIC subVIs - the chain Delacor's Event\5CConvert DQMH Event.vi runs behind its dialog\2C with no dialog and no keystroke. That is the only conversion Delacor offers.\0A\0AChain\3A lvdqmh_pick_event.vi with Event Types to Parse = Request (no Wait)\2C Delacor's own filter\2C so only convertible events are listed -> Project\3AActive Project -> Convert Event.vi -> lvdqmh_close_modules.vi. Convert Event.vi saves the project and closes the project reference it is given\2C as it does under Delacor's dialog.\0A\0AWHY ONE HIERARCHY. Module Info carries thirteen refnums that LabVIEW releases when the top-level VI that opened them stops\2C so the parse and the scripter must run under one top-level VI.\0A\0ADRY RUN BY DEFAULT. Script? FALSE parses and reports only. Scripting also needs the module and the event found\2C no locked and no unsaved module - Delacor's convert dialog refuses unsaved modules too - and no error. Not found is not an error\3A Module Index or Event Index -1. Scripted? says whether Convert Event.vi was called.\0A\0AONE MODAL REMAINS. Convert Event.vi itself opens a One Button Dialog when it meets a non-standard wiring pattern in Main.vi's event handling loop\2C and a modal stops LabVIEW's gRPC service. A module Delacor scripted does not trigger it. Convert Event.vi is never handed an incoming error.\0A\0ARequires DQMH installed\2C a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE\2C and lvdqmh_pick_event.vi and lvdqmh_close_modules.vi loaded. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.
